post-shiproom-hygiene-check.prompt:
IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. Read the data and post hygiene summary to Teams.

Steps:
0. CHECK FRESHNESS: Read modification time of `${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/mScrumMaster/hygiene-teams-summary.json`. If the file was NOT modified today, output 'Hygiene data is stale (last modified: {date}). The mScrumMaster/shiproom-hygiene-check job may not have run yet.' and exit.
1. Read `${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/mScrumMaster/hygiene-teams-summary.json`. If missing or empty, output 'No hygiene summary data.' and exit.
2. Parse all check arrays: check2b (Blocked Features), check4 (missing estimates/parent), check5 (bugs moved to current sprint), check6 (stale tasks moved for review), check7 (Proposed bugs >24h), check8 (Committed Features outside semester), check9 (stale bugs >90d), check10 (Ring target dates past due), check11 (missing sign-offs), check12 (invalid Ring date ordering R4<=R0), check13 (required training compliance <100%).
3. If ALL arrays are empty, output 'No hygiene issues to post.' and exit. Do NOT post an empty message.
4. Read the HTML template at `${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/templates/mPoster-hygiene-teams-summary.html`. Build a Teams message: only include sections that have items. Omit sections with 0 items entirely. CRITICAL: List ALL items from each check array -- do NOT truncate, summarize, or add '... and N more'. Every single row must appear in the table.
5. Post to Teams channel:
   - Team/Group ID: 31ee74d6-0a8f-41a6-b0da-c4d9e3a1db3b
   - Channel ID: 19:183d481e40af45d09aac7322433fc7ab@thread.tacv2
   - Channel name: Meeting US (PRODUCTION)
6. Build @mentions for ALL unique owners that appear in the check items, plus CC Josh Xu. For each unique owner email in the data:
   a. Look up AAD ID via Graph API: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/{email}?$select=displayName,id
   b. In the HTML body, use `<at id="{N}">{displayName}</at>` for EVERY occurrence -- each row gets its own incrementing id (even if same person). Example: Paresh in row 1 = `<at id="0">Paresh Mewada</at>`, Paresh in row 2 = `<at id="1">Paresh Mewada</at>`.
   c. Build the `mentions` array with one entry per `<at id>` tag. Same user can appear multiple times with different ids.
   d. Josh Xu (90b98fe6-a80b-46e1-9209-b5ebcdf6da6b) is always included as CC.
7. Save the initial Graph API payload (with original mention ids) to ${SRC_ROOT}/tmp/mPoster-hygiene-teams.json.
8. CRITICAL: Post ONLY via the Python script below. Do NOT use curl, do NOT use MCP tools, do NOT use any other method. They all mangle the mentions array.
   Run this EXACT script as a single python command:
   ```
   python ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/scripts/post-hygiene-to-teams.py
   ```
   This script reads mPoster-hygiene-teams.json, re-indexes mentions, posts via Python requests, saves response to mPoster-hygiene-teams-response.json, and prints the message ID.
   If the script does not exist, create it first with the logic below, then run it.
   Verify the script prints HTTP 201 and a message ID.
post-shiproom-hygiene-check.description: Posts shiproom hygiene summary (checks 2b, 4-11) to Teams Meeting US channel (currently testing channel)
